scanNote:
AmE-BrE qo'llanmasining ikkinchi (oxirgi) beti. Bosilgan bet raqami: 165.

'Others' bo'limining davomi — to'liq ikki betlik ustunlar, taxminan 90 juft so'z.

⚠ KITOB TAKRORI: 'overalls' IKKI MARTA berilgan — chap ustunda 'overalls → jeans, dungarees', o'ng ustunda 'overalls → dungarees'. Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri, lekin bir so'z ikki joyda.

⚠ KITOB XATOSI (tinish): 'sofa,settee, couch' — birinchi verguldan keyin bo'sh joy yo'q.

⚠ E'TIBOR: 135-betda tushuntirilgan qavat farqi bu jadvalda rasman bor: 'first floor, second floor etc → ground floor, first floor etc'.

⚠⚠ ENG MUHIM JUFTLAR:

   AmE           BrE
   ────────────  ────────────
   elevator      lift
   fall          autumn
   movie         film
   soccer        football
   vacation      holiday
   sick          ill
   line          queue
   sneakers      trainers
   mail          post
   math          maths


⚠⚠ XAVFLI JUFTLAR (bir so'z — ikki
  mamlakatda BOShQA narsa):

  1) PANTS:
     AmE 'pants' = ShIM
     BrE 'pants' = IChKI KIYIM!
     ⚠ Britaniyada shim — 'trousers'.

  2) VEST:
     AmE 'vest' = nimcha (kostyum osti)
     BrE 'vest' = MAYKA (ichki kiyim)
     ⚠ Britaniyada nimcha — 'waistcoat'.

  3) SUSPENDERS:
     AmE 'suspenders' = shim ushlagich
     BrE 'suspenders' = paypoq ushlagich!
     ⚠ Britaniyada shim ushlagich —
     'braces'.

  4) PUBLIC SCHOOL:
     AmE 'public school' = DAVLAT maktabi
     BrE 'public school' = XUSUSIY
        QIMMAT maktab (Eton kabi)!
     ⚠ Britaniyada davlat maktabi —
     'state school'.

  5) FIRST FLOOR:
     AmE = yerdagi qavat
     BrE = yerdan YUQORIDAGI qavat
     ⚠ 135-betda ko'rganmiz.


⚠ 'Z' HARFI:

     AmE: 'zee' [zi:]
     BrE: 'zed' [zed]

  ⚠ Alifboning oxirgi harfi ikki mamlakatda
  BOShQAChA o'qiladi!


⚠ 'FORTNIGHT' — QIZIQ SO'Z:

  BrE 'a fortnight' = IKKI HAFTA

  ⚠ Qadimgi inglizcha 'feowertyne niht'
  (o'n to'rt kecha) dan qisqargan.

  ⚠ Amerikada bu so'z deyarli
  ishlatilmaydi.


⚠ 'HOOVER' — BREND NOMIDAN FE'L:

  BrE 'to hoover' = changyutgich bilan
  tozalamoq.

  ⚠ 'Hoover' — changyutgich kompaniyasi
  nomi edi; so'z tilga singib ketgan.

  ⚠ Shu kabi: 'Sellotape' (skotch) ham
  brend nomi.


⚠ KITOB TAKRORI:

  'overalls' IKKI MARTA berilgan:
     chapda:  overalls → jeans, dungarees
     o'ngda:  overalls → dungarees

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri, shunchaki
  takror.

points.uz: AmE 'pants' = shim; LEKIN BrE da 'pants' — ichki kiyim!
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ ENG KULGILI XATO ChIQIShI MUMKIN BO'LGAN
JUFT.

Britaniyada 'I like your pants' desangiz —
ichki kiyim haqida gapirgan bo'lasiz!

Britaniyada shim — 'TROUSERS'.

⚠ Jadvalda ham bor: AmE 'shorts (underwear)'
= BrE 'pants'.

points.en: AmE 'public school' = BrE 'state school'  —  BUT BrE 'public school' = an expensive private school!
points.uz: AmE 'public school' = davlat maktabi; BrE da esa 'public school' — qimmat XUSUSIY maktab!
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ ENG PARADOKSAL JUFT.

Britaniyada 'public school' — Eton, Harrow
kabi QIMMAT XUSUSIY maktablar!

Davlat maktabi esa 'STATE school'.

⚠ Tarixiy sabab: bu maktablar qadimda
'hammaga ochiq' (public) bo'lgani uchun
shunday atalgan.

points.en: AmE 'elevator' = BrE 'lift';  AmE 'fall' = BrE 'autumn';  AmE 'movie' = BrE 'film'.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan uch juft.

⚠ AmE 'fall' — barglar TUSHISHI ('to fall')
dan olingan.

⚠ 'movie' — 'moving picture' (harakatlanuvchi
surat) qisqartmasi.

⚠ Amerikada 'football' — AMERIKA FUTBOLI
(qo'l bilan o'ynaladigan boshqa sport)!

Biz biladigan futbol u yerda 'soccer'.

⚠ QIZIQ: 'soccer' so'zining o'zi Britaniyada
paydo bo'lgan ('asSOCiation football'
qisqartmasi), keyin u yerda unutilgan.

points.en: AmE 'first floor' = BrE 'ground floor'; AmE 'second floor' = BrE 'first floor'.
points.uz: AmE 'first floor' = BrE 'ground floor' (yerdagi qavat); AmE 'second floor' = BrE 'first floor'.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 135-betda ko'rgan qoidamiz — endi jadvalda
rasman.

BrE: ground floor (yerdagi) → first floor
(undan yuqoridagi).

⚠ Britaniyada 7-qavat — yerdan 8-qavat!

points.en: AmE 'z' is pronounced 'zee'; BrE 'z' is pronounced 'zed'.
points.uz: AmE da 'z' harfi 'zi' deb, BrE da 'zed' deb o'qiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Alifboning OXIRGI HARFI ikki mamlakatda
boshqacha o'qiladi!

⚠ Nol ham boshqacha: AmE 'zero';
BrE 'nought' yoki 'oh' (telefon raqamlarida:
'oh-seven' = 07).

⚠ Qadimgi inglizcha 'feowertyne niht'
(O'N TO'RT KECHA) dan qisqargan.

⚠ Britaniyada juda ko'p ishlatiladi:
'See you in a fortnight!'

⚠ Amerikada bu so'z deyarli ishlatilmaydi.

points.en: BrE 'to hoover' and 'Sellotape' come from brand names.
points.uz: BrE 'to hoover' (chang yutmoq) va 'Sellotape' (skotch) — brend nomlaridan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Hoover' — changyutgich kompaniyasi;
nomi FE'Lga aylangan: 'to hoover the
carpet'.

⚠ 'Sellotape' (BrE) = 'Scotch tape' (AmE) —
IKKALASI ham brend nomi!

⚠ O'zbekchada ham shunday: 'skotch' —
aslida brend nomi.

exercises.instructionEn: Quick check: choose the British English word.
exercises.instructionUz: Tezkor tekshiruv: Britaniya inglizchasidagi so'zni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
MUSTAHKAMLASh MAShQI.

  ⚠ Bu mashq kitobda yo'q — ikki betlik
  jadvalni mustahkamlash uchun qo'shildi.

  Har savolda AmE so'z beriladi — BrE
  muqobilini toping.

  ⚠ Enterprise kitobi BrE da yozilgani
  uchun aynan BrE so'zlarini bilish
  muhim.

items.whyUz:
⚠ BrE 'HOLIDAY' = ta'til.

'I'm going on holiday.' (BrE)
'I'm going on vacation.' (AmE)

⚠ 'a vacancy' — bo'sh ish o'rni (boshqa
so'z!).

⚠ BrE 'QUEUE' [kyu:] = navbat.

⚠ YOZILISHI G'ALATI: 5 harf, lekin bitta
tovush [kyu:]!

'to stand in line' (AmE) =
'to queue' (BrE).

⚠ Britaniyaliklar navbatga juda jiddiy
qarashadi — navbat buzish katta odobsizlik.

⚠ BrE 'TRAINERS' = krossovka.

⚠ AmE 'sneakers' — 'to sneak' (sekin
yurmoq) dan: tovushsiz poyabzal.

⚠ BrE 'trainers' — 'to train' (mashq
qilmoq) dan: sport poyabzali.

⚠ BrE 'RUBBER' = o'chirg'ich.

⚠ EHTIYOT: AmE da 'rubber' butunlay boshqa
narsani bildiradi — maktabda bu so'zni
Amerikada ishlatmang, 'eraser' deng.

⚠ 'rubber' aslida 'to rub' (ishqalamoq)
dan.

items.uz: AmE 'schedule' (dars jadvali) = BrE da qaysi so'z?
items.whyUz:
⚠ BrE 'TIMETABLE' = dars/poyezd jadvali.

⚠ 'schedule' BrE da ham bor, lekin boshqacha
o'qiladi:
  AmE: [SKE-jul]
  BrE: [SHE-dyul]

⚠ 'time' + 'table' = vaqt jadvali.

items.uz: AmE 'principal' (maktab direktori) = BrE da qaysi so'z?
items.whyUz:
⚠ BrE 'HEADMASTER' = maktab direktori
(erkak); ayol bo'lsa 'headmistress';
zamonaviy neytral shakl: 'headteacher'
yoki 'head'.

⚠ 'head' + 'master' = bosh ustoz.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠⚠ XAVFLI JUFTLAR — BIR SO'Z, IKKI MA'NO

items.derivedUz: BrE da davlat maktabi = state school

groups.explanationUz: Alifbo va raqamlarda ham farq bor.

patterns.formula: In Britain people say [BrE], but in America they say [AmE].
patterns.exampleEn: In Britain people say 'autumn', but in America they say 'fall'.

patterns.formula: [So'z] means [A] in American English and [B] in British English.
patterns.exampleEn: 'Pants' means trousers in American English and underwear in British English.
patterns.exampleUz: 'Pants' Amerika inglizchasida shim, Britaniya inglizchasida ichki kiyim degani.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Bir so'zning ikki ma'nosini
tushuntirish uchun.

patterns.formula: I'm going on holiday for a fortnight.
patterns.exampleEn: I'm going on holiday for a fortnight.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Sof britancha gap: 'holiday' +
'fortnight'.
AmE: 'I'm going on vacation for two
weeks.'
